findings.finding: ResearchJob persists provider receipts but the production service is not wired to a provider adapter runtime; submission and provider events are recorded by trusted callers rather than orchestrated through the declared adapter protocol.
the default callback secret and artifact hash resolvers intentionally fail closed, so callback and artifact verification cannot succeed in production wiring.
ResearchJob has a cancelled terminal status and provider protocol cancel operation but exposes no cancel command; it has no checkpoint or resume model.
ResearchJob and ResearchDeliveryStatus have no partial state, so partial artifacts cannot be distinguished from success, unknown or failure.
no generic QueryJob authority exists for long internal queries; MemoryPipeline and TaskRun have useful controls but different ownership and cannot be relabeled as QueryJob.
there is no common read-only projection across TaskRun, ResearchJob and KnowledgePipelineRun for status, progress, partial artifacts, cancelability, resumability, checkpoint and receipt.
ResearchJob has no strict frontend SDK, list view or recover-by-job-ref UI, so browser refresh cannot restore a visible research lifecycle.

decisions: do not merge TaskRun, ResearchJob and KnowledgePipelineRun stores; retain their existing authorities and add a common read-only AsyncJobProjection
use ResearchJob for external C1 provider research and add trusted adapter submission, status, events, artifacts, cancel and reconcile wiring
use TaskRun or a reviewed additive QueryJob contract for long internal queries based on execution ownership; do not disguise KnowledgePipelineRun as an ad hoc query
extend ResearchJob with partial artifact receipts, checkpoint or provider cursor, explicit cancel and safe resume or retry-of semantics
wire callback secrets and artifact hash resolvers from trusted authorities before any real provider execution
add canonical list and exact get plus strict SDK and a refresh-safe job drawer that shows authority type and capability limits
unknown remains a reconcile-required state and must never trigger blind resubmission

verification.interpretation: the three authority implementations are stable in their own tested scopes; missing cross-authority projection and ResearchJob recovery controls are unimplemented requirements

nextGate: Freeze the ownership decision for internal QueryJob, close ResearchJob adapter and recovery gaps, then authorize the shared AsyncJob projection and Workshop W4-07 UI.
